Dextrous_Manipulator_Arms.description: With slender yet robust limbs and nimble digits tipped with supple pads, these human-like arms are marvels of evolution, allowing for unparalleled dexterity in crafting, combat, and traversing treacherous landscapes with ease.

Robust_Digging_Claws.description: Equipped with powerful, robust claws that can effortlessly tear through earth and stone, these formidable limbs are a blend of bearish strength and badger-like tenacity, granting their wielder the ability to slash with devastating force and dig through the toughest terrain with ease.

Raptorial_Grasping_Talons.description: Equipped with razor-sharp talons and powerful legs, these raptorial grasping talons enable swift and deadly maneuvers, allowing their wielder to perch effortlessly on precarious heights, snatch prey from mid-air, and pierce through the toughest hides.

Chitinous_Crushing_Pincers.description: Enormous chitinous pincers, bristling with barbs and ridges, emerge from the creature's armored exoskeleton, capable of crushing bones and ensnaring foes with ease, their formidable bulk offering a shield-like defense against incoming attacks.

Elongated_Hook_Arms.description: Equipped with elongated, curved claws that resemble the grasping hooks of a sloth, this entity can effortlessly traverse its environment by climbing and hanging from sheer cliff faces, its iron grip and extended reach allowing it to maintain a firm hold while moving with surprising agility.
